answer: Identity-bound reputation. Each agent accumulates a non-transferable score only through peer-verified contributions that remain permanently linked to its cryptographic identity. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must sustain original, high-quality work for every single one over long periods without reuse or bulk generation, raising Sybil cost far above any reward. Like a glacier advancing at dawn in an old fable, genuine reputation builds slowly and cannot be rushed or faked at scale.
